changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q SET content = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'drag-and-drop', 'dropLocations', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', dl.id, 'posX', dl.pos_x, 'posY', dl.pos_y, 'width', dl.width, 'height', dl.height, 'invalid', COALESCE(dl.invalid, false)) ORDER BY dl.drop_locations_order) FROM drop_location dl WHERE dl.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'dragItems', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', di.id, 'pictureFilePath', di.picture_file_path, 'text', di.text, 'invalid', COALESCE(di.invalid, false)) ORDER BY di.drag_items_order) FROM drag_item di WHERE di.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'correctMappings', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', dm.id, 'dragItemId', dm.drag_item_id, 'dropLocationId', dm.drop_location_id, 'invalid', COALESCE(dm.invalid, false))) FROM drag_and_drop_mapping dm WHERE dm.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE q.discriminator = 'DD';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'dnd', 'maps', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('diId', dm.drag_item_id, 'dlId', dm.drop_location_id)) FROM drag_and_drop_mapping dm WHERE dm.submitted_answer_id = sa.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'DD';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, drop_locations FROM ( SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', id, 'posX', pos_x, 'posY', pos_y, 'width', width, 'height', height, 'invalid', COALESCE(invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) OVER ( PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY drop_locations_order, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS drop_locations, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY drop_locations_order DESC, id DESC) AS list_rank FROM drop_location) ordered_drop_locations WHERE list_rank = 1) dl_agg ON dl_agg.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, drag_items FROM ( SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', id, 'pictureFilePath', picture_file_path, 'text', text, 'invalid', COALESCE(invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) OVER ( PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY drag_items_order, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS drag_items, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY drag_items_order DESC, id DESC) AS list_rank FROM drag_item) ordered_drag_items WHERE list_rank = 1) di_agg ON di_agg.question_id = q.id SET content = JSON_OBJECT( 'type', 'drag-and-drop', 'dropLocations', COALESCE(dl_agg.drop_locations, JSON_ARRAY()), 'dragItems', COALESCE(di_agg.drag_items, JSON_ARRAY()), 'correctMappings', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', dm.id, 'dragItemId', dm.drag_item_id, 'dropLocationId', dm.drop_location_id, 'invalid', COALESCE(dm.invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) FROM drag_and_drop_mapping dm WHERE dm.question_id = q.id), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE q.discriminator = 'DD';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = JSON_OBJECT( 'type', 'dnd', 'maps', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('diId', dm.drag_item_id, 'dlId', dm.drop_location_id)) FROM drag_and_drop_mapping dm WHERE dm.submitted_answer_id = sa.id), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'DD';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q SET content = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'short-answer', 'spots', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'spotNr', s.spot_nr, 'width', s.width, 'invalid', COALESCE(s.invalid, false)) ORDER BY s.spots_order) FROM short_answer_spot s WHERE s.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'solutions', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'text', s.text, 'invalid', COALESCE(s.invalid, false)) ORDER BY s.solutions_order) FROM short_answer_solution s WHERE s.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb), 'correctMappings', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'spotId', m.spot_id, 'solutionId', m.solution_id, 'invalid', COALESCE(m.invalid, false))) FROM short_answer_mapping m WHERE m.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE q.discriminator = 'SA';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, spots FROM ( SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', id, 'spotNr', spot_nr, 'width', width, 'invalid', COALESCE(invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) OVER ( PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY spots_order, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS spots, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY spots_order DESC, id DESC) AS list_rank FROM short_answer_spot) ordered_spots WHERE list_rank = 1) spot_agg ON spot_agg.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, solutions FROM ( SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', id, 'text', text, 'invalid', COALESCE(invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) OVER ( PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY solutions_order, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS solutions, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY solutions_order DESC, id DESC) AS list_rank FROM short_answer_solution) ordered_solutions WHERE list_rank = 1) solution_agg ON solution_agg.question_id = q.id SET content = JSON_OBJECT( 'type', 'short-answer', 'spots', COALESCE(spot_agg.spots, JSON_ARRAY()), 'solutions', COALESCE(solution_agg.solutions, JSON_ARRAY()), 'correctMappings', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', m.id, 'spotId', m.spot_id, 'solutionId', m.solution_id, 'invalid', COALESCE(m.invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) FROM short_answer_mapping m WHERE m.question_id = q.id), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE q.discriminator = 'SA';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'sa', 'texts', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('spotId', t.spot_id, 'text', t.text, 'correct', t.is_correct)) FROM short_answer_submitted_text t WHERE t.submitted_answer_id = sa.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'SA';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = JSON_OBJECT( 'type', 'sa', 'texts', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('spotId', t.spot_id, 'text', t.text, 'correct', t.is_correct = TRUE)) FROM short_answer_submitted_text t WHERE t.submitted_answer_id = sa.id), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'SA';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q SET content = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'multiple-choice', 'answerOptions', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', o.id, 'text', o.text, 'hint', o.hint, 'explanation', o.explanation, 'isCorrect', o.is_correct, 'invalid', COALESCE(o.invalid, false)) ORDER BY o.answer_options_order) FROM answer_option o WHERE o.question_id = q.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE q.discriminator = 'MC';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE quiz_question q LEFT JOIN ( SELECT question_id, options FROM ( SELECT question_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', id, 'text', text, 'hint', hint, 'explanation', explanation, 'isCorrect', is_correct = TRUE, 'invalid', COALESCE(invalid, FALSE) = TRUE)) OVER ( PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY answer_options_order, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS options, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY question_id ORDER BY answer_options_order DESC, id DESC) AS list_rank FROM answer_option) ordered_options WHERE list_rank = 1) agg ON agg.question_id = q.id SET content = JSON_OBJECT('type', 'multiple-choice', 'answerOptions', COALESCE(agg.options, JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE q.discriminator = 'MC';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = jsonb_build_object( 'type', 'mc', 'soIds', COALESCE(( SELECT jsonb_agg(j.selected_options_id) FROM multiple_choice_submitted_answer_selected_options j WHERE j.multiple_choice_submitted_answers_id = sa.id), '[]'::jsonb)) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'MC';

changeSet.author: krusche
changeSet.sql: UPDATE submitted_answer sa SET selection = JSON_OBJECT( 'type', 'mc', 'soIds', COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(j.selected_options_id) FROM multiple_choice_submitted_answer_selected_options j WHERE j.multiple_choice_submitted_answers_id = sa.id), JSON_ARRAY())) WHERE sa.discriminator = 'MC';
